release.name: v0.11.0
release.body:
## Contents

Each tarball contains `bin/` with all mallcop binaries:

- `baseline` — baseline engine + CLI
- `detector-*` — 13 security detectors
- `mallcop` — customer scan CLI
- `mallcop-finding-context` — WorkContext builder with injection defense
- `notify-{telegram,slack,teams,email}` — delivery channels

## Install

```bash
# Download (replace PLATFORM with linux-amd64, linux-arm64, or darwin-arm64)
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.11.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.11.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
sha256sum -c mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
tar xzf mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
ls bin/
```

### Features

- feat(migrate): `mallcop migrate` upgrades an existing deploy repo in place (mallcoppro-973) (#163)

### Other

- backlog: default→triage (2b9), lookup_rules metadata schema (118), github_actor degrade (2a9), SHA-pin actions (796) (#164)

---

**Full changelog**: [`v0.10.1...v0.11.0`](https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/compare/v0.10.1...v0.11.0)

release.name: mallcop-ops v0.1.0
release.body:
First public release of `mallcop-ops` — the mallcop self-extension operator CLI (`selfext --run` / `--propose` / `--scaffold-gha`).

Built from mallcop-pro @41201e4cd4d8 (includes the CODE-lane fixes that reach a GREEN gate: GLM-5.2 code model + `--code-model`, opencode config `limit.context/output`, scenario exemplars, and the `corpus.pin` trusted regen). Each tarball bundles the binary under `bin/` plus the pricing/models/lanes `config/`.

Verify: `sha256sum -c mallcop-ops-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz.sha256`.

### Features

- feat(config): shared mutation primitive + `mallcop config set` (mallcoppro-2df) (#149)

### Fixes

- fix(test): make mallcop-exam-report cf-create deterministic across fresh checkouts (mallcoppro-649) (#147)
- fix(cli): harden scan.yml template — runner-arch asset resolution, GOFLAGS=-mod=mod sidecar build (mallcoppro-977) (#146)

---

**Full changelog**: [`v0.8.0...v0.9.0`](https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0)

## Migration note (v0.8.0 -> v0.9.0)
`learning.autonomy` is now a strict enum: `non` | `semi` | `fully` (default `non`, propose-only). Configs written by v0.8.0 used `autonomy: "off"` — edit that line to `non` (or rerun `mallcop config set autonomy non`) before upgrading, or the config will fail strict decode with a loud error.

release.name: v0.8.0
release.body:
## Contents

Each tarball contains `bin/` with all mallcop binaries:

- `baseline` — baseline engine + CLI
- `detector-*` — 13 security detectors
- `mallcop` — customer scan CLI
- `mallcop-finding-context` — WorkContext builder with injection defense
- `notify-{telegram,slack,teams,email}` — delivery channels

## Install

```bash
# Download (replace PLATFORM with linux-amd64, linux-arm64, or darwin-arm64)
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.8.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/releases/download/v0.8.0/mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
sha256sum -c mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz.sha256
tar xzf mallcop-PLATFORM.tar.gz
ls bin/
```

### Features

- feat(cli): mallcop init --create-repo scaffolds+creates a customer deployment repo (mallcoppro-f3b) (#144)
- feat(selfgate): customer-tree exam-detect grades the real .wasm through the real host (mallcoppro-cc3e) (#143)
- feat(detecthost): wasip1 WASM detector sidecar runtime (mallcoppro-f70) (#142)
- feat(cli): extract cmd/mallcop into an importable cli package (mallcoppro-519) (#141)
- feat(scan): config-driven `mallcop scan` — zero-flag run over every configured source (mallcoppro-e40 / cfg-6) (#139)
- feat(detect): read mallcop.yaml for tuning/rules/baseline (mallcoppro-8b0 / cfg-7) (#138)
- feat(connect): connect/exec.ExecConnector — process-boundary cloud connector (mallcoppro-c77 / cfg-5) (#137)
- feat(init): generate runnable mallcop.yaml — zero-flag scan (mallcoppro-0a0 / cfg-2) (#136)
- feat(config): core/config loader for mallcop.yaml (mallcoppro-775 / cfg-1) (#135)
- feat(connect): core/connect.Multi — fan-in over many connectors (mallcoppro-fde / cfg-3) (#134)
- feat(selfext): K8 `mallcop collect` — store-mined coverage gaps over a versioned JSON boundary (#129)
- feat(selfext): K8 offline feedstock collectors (unmapped-action + detector-gap) (#128)
- feat(selfext): K5 declarative connector engine + K6 declarative detector engine (the data lanes) (#127)
- feat(selfgate): K7 — four-layer authored-detector safety gate (L1 isolation, L3 AST-shape, L4 resource/semantic) (#126)
- feat(selfgate): K3 invariant guard + K4 free-tier validate_proposal gate (#125)
- feat(selfext): K2 — import allow-list purity gate + widen-only tuning.yaml (first data-only FN close) (#124)
- feat(exam-detect): K1 keystone — offline detect-layer exam over the labeled corpus (#123)
- feat(store): scan publishes a deduped findings.json snapshot for consumers (#120)
- feat(feedback): operator feedback loop — dismiss/approve persists, next scan honors it

### Fixes

- fix(store): sync real index/work tree after every commit (mallcoppro-4fe) (#145)
- fix(detect): priv-escalation recognizes GCP roles/editor + M365 fullcontrol
- fix(detect): priv-escalation recognizes cloud privileged-role formats
- fix: handle 6 security-relevant unchecked errors + rename root package

### Other

- retire the declarative connector engine and declarative detector rules (mallcoppro-7bd) (#140)
- ci(selfext): exam.yml required-check gate + CODEOWNERS (mallcoppro-71c / W5) (#132)
- harden(exam): add expected_detection/ExpectedDetection to transcript leak-guard (#131)
- mallcoppro-895: K7 L3 gate — flag delete/clear builtins + alias-then-mutate (#130)

---

**Full changelog**: [`v0.7.0...v0.8.0`](https://github.com/mallcop-app/mallcop/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0)
